## 2.0.20 (HexGhoul): an investigator's superior is always the stronger
HexKagune 2.0.20 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 73**, unchanged). Built and tested by CI. **Not yet tried in game**: please report anything that looks or feels wrong.

### From your request

- **The superior in a pair of investigators is always the stronger, whatever ranks they rolled.**
  - Before this, each of the two rolled its rank on its own, so a partner could out-rank its leader.
  - Now the second of the two to appear is ranked against the first. The superior ends up at least one rank above its partner, and the partner at least one below its superior.
  - On top of that, the superior has 25% more health and hits 15% harder than its rank alone gives. So even where they can't be a rank apart (a Rank 0 superior has no rank below it), the superior is still stronger.
- **Pairs already in your world** are set right the next time they load.
- Investigators patrolling alone are unchanged.
